The user wants a joke. I should just tell one. Keep it short and genuinely funny. No need for preamble.

Let me pick something clean and actually funny. A classic two-liner works well.

Maybe avoid the most overused ones. Something with a bit of wordplay.

I'll go with one.

A man walks into a library and asks for books about paranoia.

The librarian whispers, "They're right behind you."
